chatMessage.p0: Who sent the message. User renders a right-aligned accent bubble capped at 80% of its parent; assistant fills the available parent width with left-aligned plain content. Also sets the entrance transform-origin.
chatMessage.p1: Message body. The assistant body fills its message/article width, so Markdown tables, code and other block content adapt to that width. Oversized content keeps its own horizontal scrolling. User messages render in the bubble; attachment-only messages omit the body.
chatMessage.p2: Timestamp shown before actions in the hover-revealed meta row. User-message only; ignored on assistant replies.
chatMessage.p3: Icon-only action buttons shown next to the timestamp in the hover-revealed meta row.
chatMessage.p4: Local attachments with a thumbnail, filename and size inside one bordered card.
chatMessage.p5: Side length, in pixels, of each attachment thumbnail.
chatMessage.p6: Merged onto the outer motion wrapper for max-width or spacing adjustments.
chatMessage.p7: Custom persisted attachments rendered above the bubble, alongside the existing local File attachments.
chatMessage.p8: Set always to keep the action row visible on the latest reply. Auto reveals it on hover or focus, and keeps it visible on touch.
chatMessage.p9: Additional metadata beside actions. Pass ChatMessageMeta through this slot so ChatMessage owns spacing, wrapping and visibility. Do not recreate the footer in the Block.
chatMessage.p10: Persistent identity above the message content. Compose ChatMessageAuthor here for a model logo, medium-weight model name and muted provider; it remains visible independently of actions.
chatMessage.latestProp: Shared latest-content navigation: a small outlined button with a down arrow, centered at the bottom. locale selects Chinese or English; label overrides the text; className only positions the overlay. The host shows it when away from the latest content, then scrolls and resumes following on click. CHAT_SCROLL_FOLLOW_THRESHOLD is 24px.
chatMessage.authorProp: model, logo and provider describe this response. The model name uses medium weight and the provider uses muted text. The logo is decorative; omit unavailable fields. Pass through ChatMessage.header, separately from the metric footer.
chatMessage.partsBody: Use these parts without ChatThread. Edit this message, switch versions, or copy its text. The host owns versions and persistence.
chatMessage.statusesBody: Response errors, stopped generation and failed edits reuse InlineNotice. Use emphasized danger with role=alert for errors; quiet stopped notices remain silent. The host owns retry and request state.
chatMessage.sampleError: Connection lost. Your response has been kept.
chatMessage.sampleRevision: Please review the updated design brief.
chatMessage.actionProp: Tooltip and icon-only Button with an accessible name, disabled and pressed states.
chatMessage.copyProp: Copies raw text and announces success or failure. labels overrides copy, copied and copyFailed.
chatMessage.filesProp: Accepts local File objects and persisted ChatMessageFile descriptors. Preview, filename and size share a border. thumbnailSize defaults to 64; align defaults to end; label names the list. ChatMessageAttachment renders a single card.
chatMessage.editorProp: Enter saves, Shift+Enter adds a line, Escape cancels. Reject onSave to retain the draft and show an error. disabled freezes input and saving while retaining the draft; cancellation remains available. Chinese IME composition does not submit. onCancel also closes after successful save; labels overrides edit, cancel, save and saveFailed.
chatMessage.branchProp: Zero-based index, count and onChange are controlled. Invalid or single-version ranges are hidden. labels overrides previous, next and version(index, count); displayed indexes are one-based.
chatMessage.metaProp: metrics (ttftMs, inputTokens, outputTokens, durationMs) describe this response. Place model identity in ChatMessageAuthor above the reply; model remains optional for custom footer metadata. Durations use milliseconds. Token counts use k, M and B with at most one decimal; hover or assistive technology exposes the full grouped count. Missing or invalid values are omitted; zero is preserved. locale and labels localize metric labels and full numbers.
chatMessage.sampleReply: The design brief is ready for review.
